comparisonPolicy: Actual unordered Hashtable string-key contents compare as typed maps; raw enumeration is retained outside parity. fixtureLifecycle: The same owned ScenarioRoot is reused for all surfaces. Before each probe, only known prior output.yaml/getter-error.yaml/empty-input.yaml files may be reset; unknown contents and links are rejected. Each preceding report retains file bytes and hashes.
boundaries: All fourteen complete emitted methods, direct positive helper calls and the existing missing-delegate guard are required together; counts alone do not establish execution.
The native enum/module initializer, PowerShell binding/state and hosted command regions remain reported. This is Hybrid qualification, not PowerShell-free execution.
A separate old-YamlDotNet-preload cohort is outside this 105-scenario packet; no additional production or globally installed dependency is introduced.
The full package remains external pinned input; the observer does not extract five functions or replace upstream loaders/assemblies.
Compiler input source is withdrawn by the shared harness for Built/Installed probes, while the preserved external SourceRoot remains unchanged.
